blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday expressed hope that Chinese President Xi Jinping would attend the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, saying his presence would provide an opportunity to discuss and resolve issues in the region. This comes after the Chinese Embassy recently accused Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. of deliberately delaying China’s invitation to the recent Asean Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) in Cebu.
